name: IBS WebMCP Gateway
author: ibsofts

sections.description:
🌐 Official Website | 📖 Documentation | 💁 Support

🚀 IBS WebMCP Gateway makes your WordPress site and WooCommerce store AI Agent Ready by exposing content, commerce, and website capabilities through WebMCP-compatible tools.

🚀 Unlock AI-Ready Capabilities for Your Website
With IBS WebMCP Gateway enabled:

☑️ Let AI agents discover and access your website content.
☑️ Allow AI agents to search and discover products in your WooCommerce store.
☑️ Allow AI agents to interact with carts, coupons, and shopping workflows.
☑️ Help AI agents understand your website’s navigation and structure.
☑️ Prepare your website for browser-native AI interactions and the next generation of AI-powered commerce.

🚀 What is WebMCP?

WebMCP is an emerging browser-native protocol that allows websites to expose structured tools directly to AI systems. Instead of forcing AI agents to parse webpages or analyze screenshots, WebMCP providers provide clear, structured interfaces that AI assistants can interact with programmatically. Think of it as turning your website into an AI-accessible tool layer for browser agents and automation systems.

With IBS WebMCP Gateway, your WordPress and WooCommerce website becomes AI Agent Ready.

🚀 How It Works

☑️ Install and activate IBS WebMCP Gateway on your WordPress site.
☑️ The plugin automatically makes your website content and store features available to AI.
☑️ AI can connect to your website and access your content, products, and store.
☑️ Your website is now ready to work with AI.

🚀 Core Features

WordPress Website Tools
☑️ search_posts – Search posts, pages, and custom post types
☑️ get_post – Retrieve a single post by ID or slug
☑️ get_posts – Retrieve posts and pages with pagination support
☑️ get_menu – Return navigation menu items
☑️ get_categories – List categories, tags, and taxonomy terms
☑️ get_site_info – Retrieve site name, description, URL, and language settings

WooCommerce Store Tools
☑️ wc_search_products – Search products and product categories
☑️ wc_get_product – Retrieve detailed product information
☑️ wc_get_product_categories – List product categories
☑️ wc_get_products_by_category – Retrieve products from a specific category
☑️ wc_get_checkout_fields – Retrieve WooCommerce checkout form fields

Additional features will be available in the Pro Version.

🚀 Privacy

☑️ No telemetry or usage tracking.
☑️ WebMCP tools run within your WordPress installation.
☑️ Website owners control which capabilities are exposed.
☑️ Built-in activity logging for monitoring tool usage.
☑️ Rate limiting helps protect against excessive requests.
sections.installation:
1. Navigate to WordPress Admin → Plugins → Add New.
  2. Click Upload Plugin and select the plugin ZIP file.
  3. Click Install Now to begin the installation.
  4. Once installed, click Activate Plugin.

Requirements
WordPress 6.0 or higher
PHP 7.4 or higher
WooCommerce (required for WooCommerce tools)
sections.faq:
Why do I need IBS WebMCP Gateway?

IBS WebMCP Gateway helps make your WordPress website accessible to AI assistants by exposing content, commerce, and website capabilities through WebMCP-compatible tools.

What can AI agents do on my website?

Depending on the enabled tools, AI agents can discover content, search products, access website information, understand navigation, and interact with supported website capabilities.

Does IBS WebMCP Gateway require WooCommerce?

No, WooCommerce is not required for IBS WebMCP Gateway to function. However, if WooCommerce is installed and activated, AI agents can access products, and other supported store features through WooCommerce Store Tools.

Does the plugin send my website data to external services?

No. IBS WebMCP Gateway does not collect telemetry or usage analytics. WebMCP tools run within your WordPress installation, and website owners control which capabilities are exposed.

Can developers create custom AI tools?

Yes. IBS WebMCP Gateway supports custom WebMCP tools, allowing developers to extend AI-accessible functionality for business-specific workflows, integrations, and automation.
